marginBufferPct.rationale: Metric applies: off-chain CEX futures/spot strategy sleeves imply exchange margin. Issuer publishes no exchange margin balances, maintenance/initial margin, liquidation thresholds, or excess-margin percentage. Write-time search: vault/detail and vault/performance expose no margin fields; invest/strategy riskMetrics.capitalUtilization=100 is a portfolio utilization label, not exchange margin headroom; detailedTVL ExchangeBalance fields are totalEquity/spot/futures/portfolio only (no margin or maintenance); coboTransit totals 0.00; security docs describe custodial wallet / exchange prime wallet multi-sig without quantitative buffers; no insurance or margin-buffer API on otf.lorenzo-protocol.xyz. Unit NAV 1.032257 and implied excess over 1.0 is NAV appreciation of strategy PnL, not measured per-venue margin buffer — do not misuse as marginBufferPct.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: Metric applies: first-loss / insurance / reserve-fund share would absorb strategy and venue losses before share NAV. Issuer publishes no insurance fund, reserve fund, junior tranche, or funded first-loss balance. Write-time search: vault/detail keys have no insurance/reserve-fund fields; vault/performance expense_ratio=0 and pnl=0 are not a capital buffer; invest/strategy riskMetrics.maximumDrawdown=0 is a historical performance statistic, not a funded absorption share; detailedTVL has no insurance row; FAL security + business-flow docs and USD1+ OTF guide disclaimer state Lorenzo does not manage user funds / is not responsible for strategy performance and do not size a first-loss pool; DefiLlama fees methodology notes a 5% off-chain performance fee on positive yields before NAV update — fee, not loss absorption. Do not set lossAbsorptionShare from max-drawdown 0 or from NAV>1.
